product.title: Ceylon Cinnamon 7200mg equivalent with MCT Oil
product.descriptionHtml:
True Ceylon cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum) extract in MCT oil. One softgel a day.

  • 600mg Ceylon cinnamon bark extract per softgel (12:1, made from about 7,200mg of dried bark)
  • Carried in MCT oil
  • 30 softgels per pouch (30-day supply)
  • Softgel shell contains gelatin (not vegan)

How to use: Take one softgel daily with a meal.

Guarantee: 90-Day Empty-Pouch Guarantee. Not happy? Email info@cinnora.co for a refund, even if the pouch is empty.
